description: This file is a C header file defining secure string and memory operation macros, error handling, and related utility functions for safe string operations, primarily for use with the Safe C library (safeclib). It includes macro definitions, conditional compilation for dummy API, and inline functions for safe string comparison and memory comparison.

methods.name: parseFormat
methods.description: Inline function to safely format a string with variable arguments, returning success status based on buffer size.

methods.name: strcmp_s
methods.description: Inline function to safely compare two strings with size limit, returning comparison result via pointer.

methods.name: strcasecmp_s
methods.description: Inline function to safely compare two strings case-insensitively with size limit.

methods.name: memcmp_s
methods.description: Inline function to safely compare two memory blocks with size limit.
